answer: Each identity posts a bond of 500 POA that unlocks after twelve epochs, and the panel verdict decides who keeps it. When a verdict contradicts an attester, 80 percent of that bond pays the identities it contradicted, so a farm that agrees with itself hands its stake to the honest side every round. Fifty clones tie up 25,000 POA for three days and draw nothing until the lock lifts; one honeypot answered wrong burns 400 POA apiece. A meadow sown from one sack looks even until frost sorts shallow roots from deep ones. The voyage is plotted on one prism, yet each hull pays its own toll.
